notes: The ASV writes *that* for the relative and *therein* for `בּוֹ`, so no three-morpheme *wherein* fusion under rule 22; the preposition and its own suffix (denoting the field, not the antecedent) share *therein* headed on the preposition, with the copula joining under rule 49. Large-source unit s006+s007 retained as indivisible. `יְרַנְּנוּ` → *shall sing for joy* heads on *sing*, the competing head on *joy* named in the unit note.
